songs_of_praise_and_worship.title: I Will Call Upon the Lord
songs_of_praise_and_worship.lyrics_snippet: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

songs_of_praise_and_worship.title: This is the Day
songs_of_praise_and_worship.lyrics_snippet: This is the day that the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

songs_of_praise_and_worship.title: Enter His Gates
songs_of_praise_and_worship.lyrics_snippet: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and into His courts with praise.

songs_of_praise_and_worship.title: Unto Thee, O Lord
songs_of_praise_and_worship.lyrics_snippet: Unto Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul. O my God, I trust in Thee.

songs_of_praise_and_worship.title: Thy Loving Kindness
songs_of_praise_and_worship.lyrics_snippet: Thy loving kindness is better than life; my lips shall praise Thee.

songs_of_praise_and_worship.title: Bless the Lord, Oh My Soul
songs_of_praise_and_worship.lyrics_snippet: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless His holy name.

guidance_and_the_word.title: Thy Word
guidance_and_the_word.lyrics_snippet: Thy Word is a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path.

guidance_and_the_word.title: The Law of the Lord is Perfect
guidance_and_the_word.lyrics_snippet: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul.

guidance_and_the_word.title: Trust in the Lord
guidance_and_the_word.lyrics_snippet: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not unto thine own understanding.

guidance_and_the_word.title: Thy Word Have I Hid in My Heart
guidance_and_the_word.lyrics_snippet: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

guidance_and_the_word.title: He Hath Shewed Thee, O Man
guidance_and_the_word.lyrics_snippet: To do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.

strength_and_encouragement.title: Be Still and Know
strength_and_encouragement.lyrics_snippet: Be still and know that I am God.

strength_and_encouragement.title: The Steadfast Love of the Lord
strength_and_encouragement.lyrics_snippet: They are new every morning, new every morning; great is Thy faithfulness.

strength_and_encouragement.title: Create in Me a Clean Heart
strength_and_encouragement.lyrics_snippet: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

strength_and_encouragement.title: Humble Yourselves
strength_and_encouragement.lyrics_snippet: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and He shall lift you up.

strength_and_encouragement.title: But They That Wait Upon the Lord
strength_and_encouragement.lyrics_snippet: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.

distinctly_adventist_favorites.title: Fear God and Give Glory to Him
distinctly_adventist_favorites.lyrics_snippet: Fear God and give glory to Him; for the hour of His judgment is come.

distinctly_adventist_favorites.title: Behold, What Manner of Love
distinctly_adventist_favorites.lyrics_snippet: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us.

distinctly_adventist_favorites.title: Remember the Sabbath Day
distinctly_adventist_favorites.lyrics_snippet: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

distinctly_adventist_favorites.title: Side by Side
distinctly_adventist_favorites.lyrics_snippet: Side by side we stand, awaiting God's command, worshiping the King in our own land.

full_lyrics_collection.title: Unto Thee, O Lord
full_lyrics_collection.lyrics:
Unto Thee, O Lord (Unto Thee, O Lord)
Do I lift up my soul (Do I lift up my soul)
Unto Thee, O Lord (Unto Thee, O Lord)
Do I lift up my soul.

Chorus:
O my God, I trust in Thee,
Let me not be ashamed,
Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

Verse 2:
Yea, let none that wait on Thee be ashamed,
Yea, let none that wait on Thee be ashamed,
O my God, I trust in Thee,
Let me not be ashamed,
Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

full_lyrics_collection.title: He Hath Shewed Thee
full_lyrics_collection.lyrics:
He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good;
And what doth the Lord require of thee,
But to do justly, and to love mercy,
And to walk humbly with thy God.

full_lyrics_collection.title: The Steadfast Love
Create in Me a Clean Heart
full_lyrics_collection.lyrics:
Create in me a clean heart, O God,
And renew a right spirit within me.
Cast me not away from Thy presence, O Lord,
And take not Thy Holy Spirit from me.
Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation,
And renew a right spirit within me.

full_lyrics_collection.title: This is the Day
full_lyrics_collection.lyrics:
This is the day, this is the day
That the Lord hath made, that the Lord hath made.
We will rejoice, we will rejoice
And be glad in it, and be glad in it.

Chorus:
This is the day that the Lord hath made,
We will rejoice and be glad in it.
This is the day, this is the day
That the Lord hath made.

full_lyrics_collection.title: I Will Call Upon the Lord
full_lyrics_collection.lyrics:
I will call upon the Lord (I will call upon the Lord)
Who is worthy to be praised (Who is worthy to be praised)
So shall I be saved from mine enemies. (So shall I be saved from mine enemies.)

Chorus:
The Lord liveth, and blessed be the Rock,
And let the God of my salvation be exalted!
The Lord liveth, and blessed be the Rock,
And let the God of my salvation be exalted!

full_lyrics_collection.title: Fear God and Give Glory
full_lyrics_collection.lyrics:
Fear God and give glory to Him;
For the hour of His judgment is come:
And worship Him that made heaven, and earth,
And the sea, and the fountains of waters.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
